title: P8: the options dialog labels and bounds money in the instance currency while every published figure is in the feed's
claim: On a SEK instance priced by a EUR/kWh entity feed, 5 of 20 money surfaces at 92d38ecb resolve to SEK while the feed and all 13 entity surfaces resolve to EUR: the four options-flow money fields built by config_flow._money (grid_fee_fixed, contract_fixed_price, wood_price_sek_m3, compressor_replacement_cost) and the grid-fee page's currency placeholder; on a HUF instance the grid-fee validation bound (config_flow._fee_placeholders -> grid_fee.fee_bound) is 500 against a feed-scaled 10, a sixth seam; a SEK/kWh feed (null) reads 0.
mechanism: #1657 moved the coordinator to feed-first precedence (coordinator._feed_currency or resolve_currency) but config_flow._money, _fee_placeholders and _grid_fee_errors still call currency.resolve_currency (instance-first). The value typed into those fields is added unconverted to feed-denominated prices (grid_fee.GridFeeSchedule.from_config), so the label names the wrong currency and the implausible-fee bound is scaled by the wrong currency; the price_currency repair names the disagreement but does not remove it.

evidence.unit: money surfaces disagreeing with the feed currency (of 20)
evidence.contention_note: two other D14 seats on the box; the count is contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.config_flow:_money / _fee_placeholders (via config_flow.resolve_currency), coordinator:_feed_currency, the live sensor entities' native_unit_of_measurement

perturbation.change: --perturb: config_flow.resolve_currency bound to the coordinator's precedence (coordinator._feed_currency(hass, cfg) or the instance currency), one line

null_control.note: a SEK/kWh feed on the SEK instance: every surface agrees, so the count is the precedence, not the enumeration

metric_definition: count of money surfaces (entity unit/currency attr, options money-field unit, grid-fee placeholder and bound, coordinator.currency) whose delivered currency code differs from the feed's declared code
phenomenon_property: Every surface that shows, accepts or bounds a money amount resolves its currency by one precedence: the price feed's declared currency first, the instance currency only where the feed declares none.
reproduction_steps: run the command: SEAM lines list the 4 options fields and the placeholder

pre-fix re-find: T=$(mktemp -d); git archive 3490cb16 custom_components tests | tar -x -C $T; cd $T && $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 <abs path>/currency_precedence.py --tree $T -> money_seams=18 (13 entity surfaces, 4 options fields, coordinator.currency)
proposed_fix_scope: one resolver for money surfaces that takes the entry config (feed first) used by config_flow._money, _fee_placeholders, _grid_fee_errors and the coordinator; barrier: this detector as a tests/config_flow_steps.py or tests/entities.py check (one coordinator build, about 3 s, provisional)
